purpose: Expand the creative search space and select a Direction without committing to implementation too early.

phases.purpose: Express the creative tension as a product-specific question with constraints and defaults to overcome.
phases.exit: the question distinguishes creative uncertainty from implementation

phases.purpose: Define dimensions that produce useful diversity without prescribing recipes.
phases.exit: lenses are materially different and product-relevant

phases.purpose: Create coherent independent Directions under isolated contexts.
phases.exit: candidates differ materially on at least three axes

phases.purpose: Remove concepts that fail product truth, usability, states, responsiveness, or implementation viability.
Create comparable visual specimens at the minimum fidelity needed for the decision.
Run blind pairwise visual comparison, then review system potential and risk.
phases.exit: winner selected or material tie escalated

phases.purpose: Record selected, reserve, rejected Directions and their Evidence without canonizing implementation contracts.
phases.exit: Run completes or chains to CREATE/REDESIGN canonization
